note: The Marshall Islands: nationals of Micronesia, Palau and the United States enter without a visa for an unlimited period, Taiwanese for 90 days, the EU's and the UK's for 90 in 180; nationals of the countries listed get a free 90-day visa on arrival (with a police record and a health clearance); everyone else needs a visa beforehand. Kwajalein's US military entry authorisation isn't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of the Marshall Islands
sources.said: Visitors to the Marshall Islands must obtain a visa unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries or citizens who may obtain a visa on arrival. ... Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter the Marshall Islands without a visa for the following period: Unlimited period Micronesia Palau United States 90 days Taiwan 90 days within any 180 days All European Union member states United Kingdom ... Citizens of the following countries and territories may obtain a free visa on arrival for 90 days: Andorra Algeria Argentina Australia Azerbaijan Barbados Belize Bosnia and Herzegovina Brazil Brunei Cambodia Canada Cape Verde Chile Colombia Cook Islands Costa Rica Cuba Dominican Republic Ecuador Egypt El Salvador Eswatini Fiji French Polynesia Georgia Guatemala Honduras Iceland India Indonesia Israel Japan Kazakhstan Kiribati Kosovo Kuwait Kyrgyzstan Lebanon Liechtenstein Malaysia Maldives Mauritius Mexico Monaco Mongolia Morocco Myanmar Nauru New Caledonia New Zealand Nicaragua North Macedonia Papua New Guinea Paraguay Peru Philippines Russia Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Samoa Seychelles Singapore Solomon Islands South Africa South Korea Sovereign Military Order of Malta Switzerland Tajikistan Thailand Timor-Leste Tonga Turkey Turkmenistan Tuvalu Ukraine United Arab Emirates Uruguay Vanuatu Vatican City Vietnam
